Stock market news | SEBI Proposes Tenure Limits for Exchange Chiefs, Directors

On 20 November 2026, the Securities and Exchange Board of India proposed changes to governance norms for market infrastructure institutions. The proposals include limiting managing director tenures to eight years and public interest director tenures to two three-year terms.
